resource.name: email-intake
resource.description: Provider-agnostic inbound mailbox capture: retrieves incoming email correspondence from a mailbox an Admin configures, either one organization-wide default or a separate mailbox per department.

suggestions.name: Gmail API
suggestions.description: Google Workspace mailbox; polling or push notifications via the Gmail API with OAuth.

suggestions.name: Microsoft Graph (Outlook/Microsoft 365)
suggestions.description: Mailbox access via Microsoft Graph, with OAuth and webhook subscriptions for new mail.

suggestions.name: Generic IMAP
suggestions.description: Direct IMAP polling against any mailbox provider — no vendor-specific API, works with most hosted email.

suggestions.name: SendGrid Inbound Parse
suggestions.description: A dedicated inbound-email address is parsed and POSTed to the app as a webhook, avoiding mailbox polling entirely.
